<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

# Weekly XPU consolidation report

- Mode/date: LIVE — 2026-10-05 (America/Vancouver)
- Main: `efb62ce269b499123e2d1c89005ee4cea8c31098`
- Local branch: `xpu/weekly-simple-model-enablement-2026-10-05`
- Fork branch: https://github.com/airMeng/sglang/tree/xpu/weekly-simple-model-enablement-2026-10-05
- Publication: branch pushed; upstream draft PR creation is pending a GitHub credential with pull-request write access

## Included

- #40774 — @yao-matrix: two-line TorchCodec/TorchCodec-XPU 0.15 alignment for the PyTorch 2.13 XPU stack. The old source context had unrelated dependency drift; its exact net change was replayed mechanically. Kernel-independent.
- #41088 — @vshekhawat-hlab: partial-RoPE XPU fallback to the existing native path; no new kernel API. Kernel-independent.
- #41142 — @vshekhawat-hlab: restores the optional `dec_lock_ref` default declared by the base interface. Kernel-independent.
- #41406 — @ckvermaAI: approved six-line XPU ring-attention admission/LSE-shape correction using the flash-attention call already on `main`; no new kernel import or signature. Kernel-independent.
- #41523 — @Amrutha-M05: approved `intel_xpu` HiSparse DSA routing, bf16 policy, and focused tests. Kernel-independent.
- #41730 — @desmond-intel: skips visual-token-mask allocation on decode/image-free batches while preserving image prefill. Kernel-independent.
- #41773 — @desmond-intel: routes `DLLM_EXTEND` through the existing XPU extend-metadata builder. Kernel-independent.
- #42597 — @pavansivaram: BMG choices and commands in the Qwen3.6 cookbook selector. Documentation/UI-only and kernel-independent.

All eight source PRs remain open and Ready for Review at the same audited head SHA. None has an unresolved review thread.

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).

- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
